title: docs(qa): re-point 17 checklist items in studio-authoring, search and ux-conventions
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi984k4kwEnf4Y5P19cDN49bQ)_

Fixes #33964
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:平台测试清单里 17 个条目的步骤文字(studio-authoring 15 个、search 1 个、ux-conventions 2 个),每条 revision +1 并加一行 history。
- 为什么改:18.5.0 发版测试时跑手按原文走不通或读错的地方(锚卡 #33761 账本批次 B),不改的话下一轮跑手会重复踩坑。
- 风险与回滚:只动 docs/qa 下三个 JSON 文本，不动产品代码;回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:studio-authoring.json 的 no-entry-property-matrix(删掉 deleteBehavior 一行)、ux-conventions.json 的 write-feedback(改动最多)、search.json。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期最后一行 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 429 items`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Batch B of the v18.5.0 close-out ledger (comment 6896511848 on #33761): the item-text re-point rows for `studio-authoring.json`, `search.json` and `ux-conventions.json`, 22 rows over 17 items. Each row was re-read at `origin/main` `895783a1` and the edit starts from the residue measured there; where the item text was checkable against source, the reading is named in the table. No clause (acceptance `clause`) changed; one `verify` was respelled (hooks-tab-authoring). Every edited item has `revision` +1 and one `history` row. The area files were edited as text spans by a script and never re-serialised.

| Ledger row(s) | Item | Clause edited | What changed |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 31 | search.global-search-skips-unreadable | steps[4] | A second row-scope pair on the member's own invoice (q = its `QA-` name, which `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs` stamps `QA-` + timestamp). The member reads none of INV-1001..1012, so `q=INV` alone gives two empty sets on the member side |
| 158 | studio-authoring.access-facets-runtime | steps[2], fixtures.requires[1] | A CHECK-only policy is saved with `using: ''` (the tab seeds new policies with an empty USING, `PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx`) and restricts no read; the package needs an app so the record half of acceptance[0] can be read (else "This app can't be opened"). The record calls the RLS step steps[3]; it is steps[2] in the file |
| 161 | studio-authoring.automations-rail-and-new-flow | steps[2] | The disable leg needs a publish before 'Switched off' enters the legend |
| 162 | studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu | steps[5] | `/apps/APP/docs` → `/apps/PKG/docs`; the route is `/apps/:packageId/docs` (`ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`) |
| 163, 226, 227 | studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle | steps[0], steps[2], fixtures.requires[1] | The writable package declares `dependencies: { 'com.example.showcase': '^0' }` or the dataset query answers 409 (dependency closure); the Draft chip is per item, so a gone chip does not mean a clean package; a draft-only name is discarded through `discard-drafts`, since DELETE answers 200 "nothing to delete" and leaves it. Rows 163 and 226 are one edit |
| 164 | studio-authoring.expression-editors | steps[1], fixtures.requires[0] | `record.quantity * record.unit_price` dropped as the proven-number example. Measured at `895783a1` with `inferExpressionType` (`packages/formula`): that expression infers `unknown`, `record.est_hours * 1.1` infers `number` |
| 167 | studio-authoring.held-edit-leave-guard | steps[4] | From the Automations pillar, departure (a) is another pillar's link; the Automations link is a no-op there. The record calls it steps[2], where (a) is defined |
| 169 | studio-authoring.hooks-tab-authoring | acceptance[3].verify | The retry log prints `{"attempt":1,"maxRetries":2}` on a "[hook] retrying after failure" warn (`packages/objectql/src/hook-wrappers.ts`), not a literal '1/2' |
| 171 | studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep | fixtures.knownGaps[0] | Plant on `list.columns[0]` (how a view with list keys is stored); the sweep reports `config.columns.0`; the plant shows within about a minute (cache) |
| 172 | studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix | variants, fixtures.knownGaps[0] | The `field.deleteBehavior` row leaves the matrix as step 4 says: the field inspector offers the control (`offeredDeleteBehaviors`, `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`). Variants after it shift down by one. `flow.errorHandling` names its observable: three failed runs in `/runs`, one per attempt (`retryExecution`, `engine.ts`) |
| 174 | studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display | steps[1], steps[7] | Customize sends no write (the canvas re-runs a read); the view's end-user render is `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/VIEW`, not the 'In-Progress Tasks' nav entry, which is a filtered object entry (`nav_slice_in_progress`) |
| 175 | studio-authoring.packaged-automation-studio-lock | steps[3] | The New dialog opens on 'When a record is created' and needs an Object; the scratch flow picks 'When a button or another automation starts it'. The ITEM_LOCKED wording is product #33345, not edited |
| 176 | studio-authoring.picklist-bound-select | fixtures.requires[0] | A `/tmp` copy with symlinked `node_modules` and `packages` is the default; the linked-worktree recipe stays as the alternative (it writes the shared `.git`) |
| 177 | studio-authoring.summary-field-authoring | steps[0] | The type is labelled 'Rollup' (`engine.fieldType.summary`), stored as `summary` |
| 228 | studio-authoring.flow-status-matches-runtime | steps[4] | The launch entry is the canonical boot with `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1` on a fresh DB; any port does (`.claude/launch.json` read) |
| 180 | ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason | variants[5] | 'Reassign…' renders disabled for the admin and is not rendered for a plain member, so the member leg records it not offered |
| 182, 229, 230, 231 | ux-conventions.write-feedback | steps[1], [2], [5]; variants[4], [6], [8], [11] | Update-mode import shows an inline result, no toast; the settings PUT is `/api/settings/localization`, outside `/api/v1`; import Undo answers with an 'Undone' label; Mark Done patches only `done`/`progress` (`MarkDoneAction`), so Status keeps its value; the record title link opens the subject record's page, where Approve also sits; Studio autosave needs a record and the column's 'Edit field properties' (`grid-edit-column-FIELD`); the stock currency is locked, so save another key. Row 229's "steps[2]" is the Studio autosave row, variants[8] in the file |

No row was already right at `895783a1`, and none moved to another carrier. The note on `search.command-palette-navigation` (revision 6 is not stale) needed no edit.

Forced test changes: none.

## Tests

No code changed. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` and the gate families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff were run on the final head; the commands, exit codes and the `--ran` reconciliation are in the os-dev-report comment on #33964.

## Acceptance notes

- `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason`'s steps[1] probe (the disabled reason sits on a wrapper several levels above the control) and `studio-authoring.access-facets-runtime`'s capability chips (shown only after '+ Add capability') were in the QA records but not on this card's ledger rows; not edited.
- Structural proof: a script compared each area file at `origin/main` with this branch. Every non-edited item is value-equal, the area headers are equal, each edited item changes only the fields in the table plus `revision` and one appended `history` row.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` → `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 429 items (421 active, 3 planned)`.
